Devotional

The explanation · 5 pts

Plans on Pause

Mary and Joseph had their own plans, a wedding, a home, a normal life. Then God asked them to carry His plan instead, a baby who would save the world, and they said yes, even though it turned everything upside down.

Your day has plans too. Sometimes God puts someone in front of you who needs help, like a classmate who is stuck and struggling. Stopping to help is not losing your plan. It is making room for God’s plan.

Memory verse · Luke 2:10-11 (NIV)

A Verse to Carry

“But the angel said to them, ‘Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.’”

Read it out loud, then read it again, until you can carry it with you. Further down, in Finish the Verse, you will complete it yourself, and that is when the 5 verse points land.

Activity · Case study · 10 pts

What Would You Do?

It is maths class. You finished your work early and you were looking forward to reading your new book in your free time. The classmate beside you has been stuck on the same question for ten minutes and is trying not to cry. What do you do?

The Witnesses

Mary

The young mother of Jesus. An angel told her the amazing news first, and she treasured everything that happened in her heart.

Joseph

A kind and brave man who trusted God, cared for Mary, and made the long journey to Bethlehem with her.

The Angels

God’s messengers. One spoke to Mary, one spoke to Joseph in a dream, and a whole sky full of them sang to the shepherds.

The Shepherds

Ordinary workers in the fields who heard the good news first, hurried to see Jesus, and then told everyone they met.

The Wise Men

Travelers from the east who followed a special star to find the young child, worshipped him, and gave him gifts.
